MAPPING_KEY.description:
Maps user interface selection to profiles by using specific keywords to name your profiles.
 The naming convention is [part]_[proc]_[zone]

ZONE.description: An array of available keywords for zones (if any)

items.description: Specify available [zone] keywords for profile naming

PROC.description: An array of available keywords for processes (if any)

PART.description: An array of available keywords for parts

items.description: Specify available [part] keywords for profile naming

process_items.description: Specify available [process] keywords for profile naming

INDICATOR.description: Specify what process this is from the user interface

SELECTIONS.description: An array of available keywords under this process type

items.description: Specify process keywords for profile naming
